== Course of events ==

Having admitted that he is a humbug and shown the devices behind his fearsome guises, and only after delaying for days until the Scarecrow threatened to summon the Winged Monkeys, Oz turns to the matter of what he owes his visitors. Rather than grant the requests at once, he tells Dorothy that he will give brains, courage, and a heart the next day, and he asks for time to find a way to send her back to Kansas.

This promise sets the course for what follows. Oz goes on to recount his own past as a ventriloquist and balloonist who drifted into the country and was mistaken for a great wizard, and it is only later, after Dorothy melts the Wicked Witch of the West, that the four travelers return to the Emerald City, where the Guardian of the Gates admits them again and locks the green spectacles onto their eyes.
